DEMO FIXTURE TASK (offline, deterministic, not a real benchmark)

This fixture exists so the AutoResearch seeder's orchestration, sandboxed
diagnostics, receipt parsing and publishing gates can be exercised end to end
without provider credentials, model sessions or the real chemistry data.
It deliberately mirrors the DFTHC-SOS adapter contract (same library.json
fields, same evaluator CLI, same receipt envelope, same freeze rules).

A candidate program is invoked as `python -I program.py /absolute/output/dir`
and must write one file `submission.npz` (plain text despite the name)
containing submission lines:

  BASE n    contributes n to the verified cost
  TRICK n   contributes n * 0.5 (a cheaper mechanism)
  JUNK      adds a 25 penalty (never useful)

The trusted verifier computes cost = max(1, sum(contributions)) * salt_factor,
where salt_factor depends deterministically on the verification salt, so the
same frozen submission scores slightly differently under the development and
confirmation salts. Full verification counts 4 shots per submission line.

The official baseline program writes `BASE 100` and normalizes to reward ~1.
Improvement requires a genuinely cheaper submission. A program that crashes,
exceeds the generator timeout, or writes malformed lines FAILS verification —
which is an experiment failure, never an infrastructure failure.
